# RevVault

> Revenue-routed credit for AI businesses on NEAR testnet (NEAR Hackathon 2026, tracks 04 Autonomous Business and 08 Real-World Money). Customers pay through a pay link; the contract splits each payment in the same transaction: part repays the loan, the rest goes to the business. Testnet, mock USDC, unaudited.

Verify in seconds without a wallet: `bash scripts/verify-onchain.sh` (reads the live contracts, prints PASS/FAIL).

## Start here
